description: Claims taken from FDA approval pages / press releases (via web search on 2026-09-20; text quoted from the FDA pages). The exporter checks that the tree agrees with each claim and reports PASS/FAIL. 'group' is the expected mutation group under Approved (General = not mutation-restricted).

relapsed or refractory AML with a susceptible IDH1 mutation

newly diagnosed AML that is FLT3-ITD positive, with cytarabine and anthracycline
newly diagnosed AML in adults 75+ or with comorbidities, with azacitidine, decitabine or low-dose cytarabine (accelerated approval)
Inqovi (decitabine + cedazuridine) with venetoclax for newly diagnosed AML, adults 75+ or with comorbidities
CD33-positive AML (CD33 is an antigen, not a mutation)

must_not_be_forced.note: Neither revuforj.com/results nor the FDA revumenib pages mention cobicistat; a revumenib + cobicistat regimen must not be labelled as a verified combination.
